title: D1: typed-bytes payload envelope (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16), option C: every payload = {type (URN or JSON-LD type), contentType (application/json, application/ld+json, CBOR...), body bytes}. Signatures over exact bytes, no canonicalization (replaces §13.1.1 URDNA2015 pipeline). Inside MLS, the MLS sender signature suffices; object-level signatures only for objects verified outside a group (Space state, compliance records), using a standard container (COSE_Sign1 or JWS, pick during spec writing). Signed objects are passed byte-for-byte, never re-serialized.
close_reason: Decided by Mark 2026-10-16 and applied in spec (13, 05, 06, 11, 14, profiles of jmap family)
